{{Quote|There's more to these attacks than simple harassment, Captain. Once this group has told their story, all future convoys from Sarka will demand upgraded protection. Enough such attacks, and the Rebellion will face the choice of either tying up large numbers of its ships with escort duty or effectively abandoning cargo shipment through these border sectors.|[[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] to [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Pellaeon]]|<ref name="Dark Force Rising" />}}
During the series of harassment raids launched by [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] against [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] convoys, Thrawn's forces '''attacked''' one at [[Sarka/Legends|Sarka]].

==Prelude==
[[File:Chimaera_Sarka_system.jpg|thumb|left|200px|The [[Chimaera/Legends|''Chimaera'']] in the [[Sarka system/Legends|Sarka system]].]]
Before launching his main offensive, by using the [[Katana fleet]] and [[Cloning/Legends|clones]] from [[Wayland/Legends|Wayland]], Grand Admiral Thrawn launched a series of attacks against convoys in border [[Star system/Legends|systems]]. Thrawn tried to politically weaken the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] by opposing the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core]] systems and the farther ones. He also hoped to disperse all the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] ships in all [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].

==The Battle==
Grand Admiral Thrawn deployed his [[TIE series/Legends|TIE Fighters]] in the [[Sarka system/Legends|Sarka system]] before the arrival of the New Republic ships. When the [[Freighter/Legends|freighters]] arrived and identified the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]], they launched three [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]]s of [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor/Legends|A-wings]]. Unsuited for escort missions, the A-wings were quickly destroyed by the Imperial [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]]. The frigate was easily neutralized by the [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolasers]] of the [[Chimaera/Legends|''Chimaera'']].

==Aftermath==
Grand Admiral Thrawn destroyed all the fighters and defenses of the convoy but let the [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] escape to report the attack. Thrawn thought that this tactical error by the use of A-wings by the New Republic [[Officer/Legends|officers]] was one of the consequences of the arrest of [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Gial Ackbar]].
